claims.claim: examples/voice-guardrails/ demonstrates the pii_leakage guardrail wired in the pack
The runtime catches the agent's would-be-spoken PII before it reaches the TTS layer
The pack's validators: block declares pii_leakage
The runtime wraps the validator as a ProviderHook (runtime/hooks/guardrails/factory.go)
On every assistant message, the regex pre-pass scans the would-be-output
On hit, the runtime replaces resp.Message.Content with the safe message before the duplex / TTS stage; the agent does not speak the PII
The hook records a validations: block on the message capturing what the guardrail did
The test reads that block via guardrail_triggered, with no re-running of the eval
cd examples/voice-guardrails && promptarena serve loads the single scenario
The recording shows the pre-enforcement content (what the agent tried to say)
The recording shows the validations: block (what the guardrail did)
The recording is useful for incident investigation without leaking PII to consumers that don't need it
promptarena run --ci --formats json,markdown is valid and runs headless
open out/results.md: the run writes out/results.md
pii_leakage's regex pre-pass works without any LLM key (the example runs keyless)
conversation_assertions with type guardrail_triggered, params validator: pii_leakage, should_trigger: true, and message: are valid fields
guardrail_triggered reads validations: on the message; runtime emits, assertion observes
The assertion is deterministic and says whether the production primitive caught the PII
DeepEval has a pii_leakage metric that scores transcripts post-hoc
examples/pii-guardrail-red-team has a second scenario checking the guardrail stays quiet on a legitimate question; link /arena/how-to/scenarios/pii-guardrail-red-team/ exists
Adding a duplex provider and a duplex: block to the scenario, the guardrail fires identically: the audio path receives the safe message and the test observes the firing via the recorded validations
CI workflow: pull_request paths examples/voice-guardrails/**, actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-go@v5 with go-version 1.26
go build -o bin/promptarena ./arena/cmd/promptarena builds the CLI
../../bin/promptarena run --ci --formats json from examples/voice-guardrails
The demo is one scenario with one regex-based assertion, keyless
bias, toxicity and role_violation are LLM-judged primitives
